'''Havox''' was<ref name="TOR" /> a [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Jedipedia-NPCData" /> [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconsituted Sith Empire]]. During the war, they worked on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quesh]] selling various weapons from a stall in the [[Republic Operational Headquarters]]. While at the store, which was exposed to Quesh's toxic [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], they wore a [[Color/Legends|green]] uniform, a [[Breath mask/Legends|breath mask]] and also carried a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]]. Havox had fair skin, [[Color/Legends|brown]] hair, and green [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Havox appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a Weapons Vendor for Republic players on Quesh.<ref name="TOR" /> With the release of Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]],<ref name="4.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/10202015/game-update-4.0-knights-fallen-empire-early-access|text=Game Update 4.0: Knights of the Fallen Empire Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref> Havox was removed from the game along with the rest of the Weapons Vendors.<ref name="TOR" /> Their position is also marked on a map in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]'', a game guide released by [[Prima Games]].<ref name="Explorer">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]''</ref>
